meta.title: Maintra 2.0 · Update coming this October
meta.description: Maintra 2.0 arrives in October: a new garage, offline maps that count your kilometres, a car you can lend, share or sell with its history, 11 languages. The service book for people who look after their own cars. Try the app right on the page.
meta.og_description: The service book for people who look after their own cars, rebuilt from the first screen. Try it right on the page.
a11y.phone: Maintra 2.0, running on the page. Tap anything.
hero.lede: The service book for people who look after their own cars. Rebuilt from the first screen: a new garage, offline maps that count your kilometres, a car you can lend, share or sell with its history, eleven languages.
hero.note: Free to start. Already have Maintra? 2.0 comes as a normal update, and your records stay where they are.
hero.cue: Scroll down. The phone below is the real app.
spec.title: New in 2.0
tour.title: This is the app. Press things.
tour.lede: Not a video. The phone runs the same screens the app does: tap the photo, open the plan, scan a receipt, lend Paj to a mate. Scroll and each part explains itself.
ch.garage.name: Garage
ch.garage.title: Your car on the wall
ch.garage.body: Open Maintra and the first thing you see is your car: a real photo in a polaroid, the odometer stamped on it like on film, and the one number that matters right now. Below it, only what's late or close. Everything else is one tap away.
ch.garage.s3: You choose what sits under the photo
ch.log.name: Log it
ch.log.title: Snap the receipt. That's the job.
ch.log.body: A garage invoice, a fuel slip, a receipt for parts, in any language. Maintra reads it and turns it into records: parts, labour, cost, mileage. You check every line before it's saved, and a misread costs you nothing. Hands black from work? Hold the plus and just say what you did.
ch.log.s3: AI works out what it is
ch.plan.name: Plan
ch.plan.title: Knows what's due, and says why
ch.plan.body: Maintra builds a plan from your car and your mileage: what's late, what's soon, what can wait. Every line says when and why. Mark a job done and the countdown starts over. Before a long drive, it checks the car for you.
ch.plan.hint: Open a job, mark it done.
ch.money.name: Money
ch.money.title: What the car really costs
ch.money.body: Every hryvnia, euro or dollar in one place, converted at the rate of the day you spent it. Driving and owning apart: per kilometre, per month, since you bought it. A fine reminds you before the half price runs out.
ch.map.name: Map
ch.map.title: Offline maps that count your kilometres
ch.map.body: Download your region once and drive without signal. Maintra leads the way, counts the trip and adds the kilometres to the odometer, so the plan stays right. Speeds and the fastest stretch, if you're curious. The track never leaves your phone.
ch.keys.name: Hand over
ch.keys.title: Lend it. Share it. Sell it with the history.
ch.keys.body: Lending Paj till Sunday? Your mate gets the car on their phone, logs fuel and kilometres, and when the keys come back you see their entries kept apart. Drive it together with your partner. Or sell it, and the whole service history moves to the new owner. A car with its history sells better.
ch.keys.s1: Three ways to hand it over
ch.keys.hint: Tap the keys at the top.
ch.tyres.name: Tyres and papers
ch.tyres.title: Tyres by age. Papers under lock.
ch.tyres.body: Tread on every wheel, rotation, and the date the rubber was made: after six years it hardens, whatever the tread says. The car sheet keeps oil specs, filter numbers and tyre sizes on one page. Insurance and registration live in a vault encrypted on your phone, with a key only you hold. No recovery button. Inconvenient on purpose.
ch.tyres.hint: Open the set on the car.
ch.yours.name: Make it yours
ch.yours.title: Your garage. Your look. Your language.
ch.yours.body: Dark, light or like your phone. Then the themes: Red light for night drives, Field, Blueprint, Logbook, Rose. A theme changes the background and the accent; red still means late. And the whole app now speaks eleven languages, right to left too.
ch.yours.hint: Pick a theme on the phone.
why.title: Made for the people who do the work
why.lede: No feature list for the sake of it. Each of these came from someone who lost a receipt, a record or a weekend.
why.free.b: Records, fuel, plan, reminders, stats, export. Free on every plan, for good. You pay only for what costs money to run: the AI.
why.offline.b: Everything lands on your phone first. Underground parking, a garage in a village, a mountain pass: it works, and syncs later.
why.private.b: Car photos and trips stay on the phone that took them. Nothing is sold, nothing follows you around.
why.export.b: JSON, CSV or a PDF service book, on every plan, whenever you like. Delete the account in the app and it's gone.
why.ai.b: Whatever it reads, you check before it's saved. What it can't read stays empty, and where every value came from is marked.
why.vault.b: Documents are encrypted on the phone before they're uploaded. Maintra never holds the key.
why.tyres.t: Tyres by date, not just tread
why.tyres.b: Rubber hardens after six years. Maintra reads the DOT code and tells you, whatever the tread says.
why.money.t: Your currency, the rate of the day
why.money.b: 50 currencies, 45 countries. A receipt from 2019 counts at the 2019 rate.
why.vehicles.b: Petrol, diesel, LPG, hybrid or electric. One garage for all of them.
why.import.b: Bring your history from a spreadsheet or another app. No AI in the import, so the numbers match line for line.
why.devices.b: iPhone, iPad, Android phones and tablets, widgets on the home and lock screen. Siri and Apple Watch for quick entries.
why.human.t: A person, not a call centre
why.human.b: Write to support and the person who built it answers.
maker.title: Built in a garage, not an office
maker.p1: I'm ROK. I keep a 2008 Pajero on the road with my own hands, and Maintra started because I kept forgetting which oil went in, how much, and when. Receipts in the glovebox, notes in a spreadsheet, chats with AI: it all got lost.
maker.p2: So I built the book I wanted. More than a thousand drivers use it today, and 2.0 is what they told me: calmer screens, less typing, and the things I was missing in my own garage. Maps that work in the woods, and a way to lend the car to a mate and still know what happened to it.
maker.q1: You remember the big repairs without an app. It's the small things that get lost: which filter exactly, how much went in, when it was last done.
maker.q2: I didn't want to build another subscription. Anything that costs nothing to run stays free.
maker.caption: ROK · Pajero 2008
maker.photo_alt: ROK, the developer of Maintra, at the wheel of his black Pajero
plans.title: Pay for the AI. The book is free.
plans.free_b: The whole service book, fuel log, plan, reminders, stats, places, wishlist, import and export. One car, and a few AI entries to try.
plans.pro_b: Any number of cars, documents and tyre sets. More AI entries and plans every month. Receipts kept as proof, tread and rotation, Siri and Apple Watch.
plans.vip_b: The most AI, and the AI mechanic chat that knows your car's history.
plans.note: Prices come from the App Store and Google Play, in your currency. Cancel any time.
faq.title: Before you ask
faq.a1: When it's ready and tested on real phones in real garages. If Maintra is installed, the update comes to you. Nothing to watch for.
faq.a2: No. It's an update of the same app, and the service book stays free.
faq.q3: Will my records come with me?
faq.a3: Yes. Same app, same account. Everything you've logged is there after the update.
faq.a4: Both, phones and tablets. Your data syncs between them.
get.title: October. Free update.
get.body: Install Maintra today and 2.0 arrives on its own. Start with the car you're fixing this weekend.
foot.tagline: A smart maintenance tracker for your garage.
